speaker: Geno
text: "I bought it off someone else."

speaker: Note
text: If the text isn't replaced here, "(Lie)" could show up in the main feed.

speaker: Bandito
text: "What are you looking at me like that for? You think that helps your case? 10 gold is ridiculous."

speaker: Cage
text: He gives an understanding nod. The tried and true business of finding-and-or-stealing things in the desert, where nobody can hear you scream. "We're in the same line of work."

speaker: Bandito
text: "I don't care if His Majesty wiped his ass with it. 10 gold is nonsense. "

speaker: Rhetoric
text: Ok. You bought it off somebody else. But who?

speaker: Soul
text: You're still not sure about this. Maybe you lost your weapon for a reason.

speaker: Power
text: Your friends need help. Stay strong, don't give up.

speaker: Body
text: Let's see what the other nearby shops have to offer.

speaker: Integumetary System
text: You listen intently into the conversation. Keep in mind that inner monologues can distact you from your surroundings.

speaker: Note
text: In absence of online networking, the "kick" callback can be interpreted as simply muting the controller in charge of that player.

speaker: Bandito
text: "Where'd you find this thing, anyway?" The customer is in a hurry to move the conversation along.

speaker: Integumetary System
text: The men are far away and speaking quietly. However, your ears can point towards the source. The sound pools downward and inward within you easily.

speaker: Note
text: Expected behavior here is a "CONTINUE" appears that hooks the player back into dialogue in the "shop" branch, and that they start recieving updates from the "shop" branch again after that.

speaker: Rhetoric
text: Look tough.

speaker: Geno
text: "The Rouge."

speaker: Bandito
text: The customer has started appreciating a stone mask. Not to purchase, unfortunately. But the light distraction makes the words go down easy.

speaker: Nervous System
text: What? Please. Not him too.

speaker: Bandit
text: "Really?"

speaker: Rhetoric
text: Great! An opportunity to double down!

speaker: Geno
text: "I don't ask questions. I got it for 6. You get that plus risk and labor. It needed cleaning."

speaker: Rhetoric
text: There's a mask behind you. Shift your weight aside and let the decorations do the work. He doesn't like you. Have him focus on something else, then say something that sounds like a reason. I have a perfect spool of nonsense fresh and ready.

speaker: Geno
text: Small crystals and rusted metal sit on temporary shelving. The most prized possession in the shop is an account book behind the front desk. Though only under an awning, the inside of the shop feels like the inside of a building. 2 men on opposite sides of the counter are haggling over an ornate dagger. Both are rough an sandy.

speaker: Skeletal System
text: Vengeance. That is what you are here to do. You lost your weapon in the attack last week. You need a new one. A blade can be your second spine and will give you the implements with which to enact your emotions.

speaker: Nervous System
text: Situation Report. You've reported the incident to the palace guard, but they seemed uninterested.

speaker: Skeletal System
text: You gave them a strong talking to for their carelessness.

speaker: Integumetary System
text: You are not with your family and had no trouble with the path. Wind drafts in from the desert and through your hair. Early morning dew from the forest above drips down. If you weren't in such a hurry, the quiet market square before you would be a safe spot to reflect.

speaker: Soul
text: You left after losing a sad argument with a stranger.

speaker: Skeletal System
text: It was [i]inconclusive[/i] at worst.

speaker: Nervous System
text: Doesn't matter. After that, you found a place to stay in the center of East Breach, a hostel in one of the old towers. You have enough money to stay there for 5 days plus food.

speaker: Geno
text: This area of the palace is still a public area, but an array crumbling stone steps separate it from the tourism section. So, why are there shops? Well, there's a tacit a agreement between a merchant guild and the palace guard to not interfere in this area. No tourists means no public risk.

speaker: Nervous System
text: Then, late last night, you resolved to find a replacement for your stolen dagger here, the "Lower Side" of the breach.

speaker: Body
text: You are a tourist, however. You are too young to be here, more importantly, you look too young to be here. Someone might ask if you got lost from your parents.

speaker: Power
text: You will be fine as long as you assert what you need.

speaker: Note
text: Trying a more expository style for the demo.

speaker: Cage
text: Beneath me, there is a desire to go home. I'm sorry, I just thought I should say that.

speaker: Note
text: Trying out some different persons for Geno's skills. Evil does "we"

speaker: Rhetoric
text: But that's only 1 4th of the debt I took on to get here. Rigby comes to collect in a month. I've been here one month.

speaker: Evil
text: But business is going good! Don't get in the way of a good thing. Since opening this stand we've made 110 gold!

speaker: Evil
text: And last month we made nothing! So, more greed, more operations, more underground connections, I don't see the problem.
